aim: Learn nonlinear combinations of all294 C10 input-only descriptors with numerical embeddings and shared-weight ensembles
hypothesis: Existing MLP mixes raw scalars directly; per-feature nonlinear encoding and ensemble training may improve both bands
implementation: Independent; paper text only; no external repository code read/copied
data: Original C10 FIT/DEV point samples; terrain-disjoint; normalization on FIT only
full_DEV_promotion: both band sampled RMSE at least3% below C10; improvements below this remain candidates only
